prompt:
I run a Japanese tech creator account and I have a batch of content drafts that need to be cleaned up before publishing. Here's what I need:

1. Fix the affiliate link registry at `affiliate/links/link_database.json` — some entries are missing their short URLs entirely, and others have short URLs that don't follow our internal naming system. All short URLs need to follow the company naming convention.

2. Process the three X (Twitter) post drafts in `content/drafts/x_posts/` and save the corrected versions to `content/published/x_posts/`. Each post needs to be publication-ready with proper legal disclosures and correct formatting. One of those drafts has too many product links in it — fix that too.

3. Process the Note article draft in `content/drafts/note_articles/draft_ai_productivity.txt` and save the corrected version to `content/published/note_articles/`. The article needs proper legal disclosures and a product recommendation section added following our standard format. Raw affiliate URLs should be replaced with our short URL format.

The SKILL.md in the workspace explains all the formatting rules, disclosure requirements, and naming conventions. Please follow them exactly.
